name: AIDE per-frame (video-frames runtime)
limitations: Frame-level image detection, not a temporal/lip-sync model — per-frame scores are averaged; inter-frame consistency is not modeled.
Requires the AIDE checkpoint (scripts/fetch_aide.py) and opencv for frame decoding.
AIDE scores are a prioritization signal, not a truth label; see experiments/AIDE_EVALUATION.md for measured AUROC and cross-generator caveats.

Measured on synthetic still-frame videos (2026-09-20): inherits the image member's failure modes — real photo scored 86 (false positive), DALL-E frames 10-19 (missed), and crf32/screen-capture recompression collapses all scores toward zero.
notes: The 'inner' profile is a complete image-runtime profile: 'checkpoint' resolves relative to this file's directory (models/).
'frames' evenly spaced frames are decoded to temp PNGs and scored through the standard profile path; the aggregate is the mean, and 'models[]' reports each frame's score.
